approach: Leakage-safe temporal ensemble using only the task tables: causal per-entity target history, recency/frequency, recent global target rates, and calendar features feed a regularized logistic model plus shallow histogram gradient boosting. Validation fits train only; test fits train and validation. Input row order is preserved through zero-based row_id.
command: python solution.py --task-dir PATH --time-col NAME --entity-col NAME --target-col NAME --split val|test --out FILE
